comment: Pull requests GitHub reports as MERGED whose merge commit is not reachable
from `main`, and which tools/check_merged_prs_landed.py therefore reports
as KNOWN rather than as a finding. Issue #1342.
Every entry was merged into a base branch other than `main`. Two things
produce that: a base branch that had already been squash-merged, which
strands the work; and a stacked PR whose parent branch was later squashed
to main, which carries the work under a different commit. Ancestry cannot
tell those apart, so each entry records a VERDICT and a WITNESS, and
tools/landing_witness.py re-measures the witness on every run (issue
#1434): `added` must equal the merge's own added set; `identical` paths
must be byte-identical to the merge's copy; `drifted` paths must have
changed and name the merge's own tests that still pin them, which must
collect and pass; `absent` paths (STRANDED) must be absent. A REWORKED
entry has no file witness and is reported as UNCHECKED, not as verified.
The `note` is prose; its first verdict word must match `verdict`, and every
path it names that the merge touched must be in the witness.
This ratchet SHRINKS ONLY. An entry whose merge commit becomes reachable
from main has been merged properly after all, and the checker FAILS until
the entry is deleted. An entry may never be added to turn a red check
green: a new stranding is a defect to fix.

The earlier note said only that both files are on main, which was true and could not be checked.

1296.note: merged into agent/1196-ui-transaction-phases, already squashed to main. CARRIED by PR #1325, now measured rather than reported. The earlier note said there was no cheap witness because the merge added no files. That was wrong about the method, not about the facts: it added none, but it MODIFIED three, and two of those have not drifted. Measured on 773c6e3f6, docs/erase-report.md and tests/test_erase_report.py are BYTE-IDENTICAL to this merge's copies, which carries the 80 lines of tests it added to the latter. Its six named cases (test_every_residue_state_has_a_clause_and_no_clause_invents_a_state and the five beside it) collect and pass on main, 6 of the file's 22. src/revl/erase_report.py has drifted since and is not byte-compared; those six tests are what pin its behaviour. A modified file is a witness when it has not moved, so 'no files added' is not by itself a reason to stop looking.

1308.note: merged into agent/81-stream-tiers. REWORKED: `document_holds_stream`, added by this merge to selfhost/emit_go.rvl, is still absent from main and is deliberately not restored. Reading `subscribe` / `stream-iter` there would move those discriminants out of the go tier's `unported` baseline in tests/fixtures/selfhost_blind_spots.json on the strength of a refusal predicate. Main reaches the same outcome by the cheaper route issue #1321 took: the marker's suppression now also requires that no component be OBSERVABLE, and `component_is_observable` reads the LENGTH of a component's `body`, so a stream component is named without any stream spelling being read. Measured on 773c6e3f6 with this merge's two single-arm cases re-authored against that rule: a source-only `Stream.source()` acquisition and a subscription with no loop are both named, one marker per components entry, each holding the reference to emitting `stc-go` where the port emits its marker. Those two cases are on main in tests/test_selfhost_emit_go.py.
